feature_contracts.scope: static interface binding; behavioral results are verified separately

requirements.requirement: Decode incoming 128-bit host request packets into semantic request metadata.
Generate bounded transport packets for the external model evaluation service.
Implement firmware-visible MMIO CSR decode with read/write semantics and explicit register reachability.
Track outstanding request sequence and request IDs.
Validate response metadata and reject malformed, stale, duplicated, or timed-out responses.
Clamp accepted command recommendations to configured min/max and optional slew-rate limits.
Register and present only validated commands to the actuator interface.
Latch fault indicators for software handling and maintain conservative safe behavior after reset or fault.
host_stream_in_valid and host_stream_in_ready implement a standard valid/ready input handshake for request metadata ingress.
host_stream_out_valid and host_stream_out_ready implement a standard valid/ready output handshake for response metadata egress toward the external service/software path.

The 128-bit request packet shall be internally decoded into semantic fields that include sequence_id, request_id, flow-condition summary, geometry reference identifier, and control fields; no packet width shall exceed 128 bits.
The MMIO interface is authoritative for firmware-visible control and status. Each declared register must be reachable through address decode and produce readback when applicable.
Writable configuration registers include timeout threshold, actuator min/max limits, optional slew-rate limit, and enable bits controlling validation and limiter behavior.
Read-only status registers include current outstanding sequence, request-pending indication, latched fault summary, command-valid state, and telemetry counters.

A response is accepted only if packet format is valid, sequence_id matches the current outstanding request, the response is not stale/duplicate/older than the configured window, and it arrives before timeout expiry.
If any validation fails, actuator_cmd_valid is deasserted and the corresponding fault bit is latched.
Command limiting shall apply saturation to the configured min/max range and, when enabled, rate-of-change limiting relative to the previous accepted command value.
No silent substitute command may be generated under any condition; invalid operation inhibits output validity only.
Sequence counters, request counters, and response counters are maintained in fixed-width saturating or wrapping arithmetic as described in the register contract.
If the optional metadata FIFO is implemented, it stores only bounded header/metadata words and never large tensors or flow fields.
The memory macro, if instantiated, is FPGA-appropriate block RAM and is technology-neutral in the contract; no Sky130-specific macro is implied.

On rst_n deassertion, the module enters SAFE/IDLE control state, clears outstanding request tracking, clears MMIO read-data side effects, initializes configuration registers to conservative safe values, clears transient handshakes, deasserts actuator_cmd_valid, drives a deterministic actuator_cmd register value, and clears sticky fault latches only if explicitly permitted by the reset policy encoded in MMIO. The design does not substitute or apply a fallback command; it inhibits command validity until a fresh validated response is accepted.
